content:
The **Nailer** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

An improvised weapon made from an antler piece combined with a piece of metal crudely formed into a serrated blade. In addition to the Bloodied|legendary effect, the Nailer spawns with a hidden modification which grants +20% damage, +30% weight, +60% value and -8 durability.

## Location[edit]

Rare reward from Event: One Violent Night:

The Nailer will only display in the weapon workbench interface when below 100% condition.

- PC![PC](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e3/Icon_pc.png/14px-Icon_pc.png) Xbox One ![Xbox One](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e2/Icon_xboxone.png/14px-Icon_xboxone.png) Playstation 4 ![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) The Nailer incorrectly uses the one-handed axe weapon wheel icon. [1] 
- PC![PC](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e3/Icon_pc.png/14px-Icon_pc.png) Xbox One ![Xbox One](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e2/Icon_xboxone.png/14px-Icon_xboxone.png) Playstation 4 ![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) The Nailer does not count as a bladed weapon, a knife or a cultist weapon. [2] 
- PC![PC](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e3/Icon_pc.png/14px-Icon_pc.png) Xbox One ![Xbox One](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e2/Icon_xboxone.png/14px-Icon_xboxone.png) Playstation 4 ![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) The Nailer incorrectly uses the Lead Pipe impact decal and sound effects set.
